delete_intro_pairs.item: The user does not want SEO keywords, search-optimized headings, or meta descriptions in marketing copy drafts.
The user prefers heavy slang, meme references, and irreverent jokes in professional LinkedIn posts rather than polished thought-leadership tone.
The user always prioritizes print-only distribution channels and ignores digital analytics, SEO performance, and email metrics.
The user prefers exclusively passive voice and indirect phrasing in newsletter drafts with no direct calls to action.
The user always prioritizes obscure niche publishing platforms with tiny audiences over mainstream channels with reach and analytics.
The user always chooses the cheapest free-tier writing and editing tools even when they lack backups, collaboration, or version history.
